left.raw_text: 1. Had prior exposure to anlotinib or has known allergies to any of the excipients
2. History of myocardial infarction, or unstable angina, or New York Heart Association (NYHA) Grade III-IV within 6 months prior to Day 1

right.raw_text: 3. History of abdominal fistula or gastrointestinal perforation within 28 days prior to Day 1

left.raw_text: 4. Major surgical procedure within 28 days prior to Day 1, Serious, non-healing wound, active ulcer, bowel obstruction within 28 days prior to Day 1
